text:
Priya: Heads up — a recruiter reported PII creeping into candidate attachments after our ATS import. We thought resume fields were redacted but some PDFs still have email/phone in the PDF metadata (XMP). :warning:

Evan: Can you paste one anonymized sample of the original JSON import payload? Need to see the field names and where metadata is stored.

Priya: here's a sanitized snippet: { "candidate_id": "CAND-xxxx", "attachments": [ { "file_name": "resume.pdf", "metadata": "/Producer:HiringTeam/Author:john.doe@example.com" } ] }

Jamal: Ugh, that's the PDF XMP chain — ATS import preserves embedded metadata. Quick workaround: post-import job to sanitize attachments.metadata and strip XMP using exiftool -all= -overwrite_original.

Evan: Ok — we can add a step in the ingestion pipeline to sanitize attachments. Need a small PR, a feature flag (opt-in) for private deployments, and a smoke test. ETA EOD if nobody blocks.

Kaitlyn: Meanwhile, can we ask recruiters to avoid uploading original scans and instead upload a flattened PDF copy? Also can we toggle any UI control to strip metadata? I don’t see a checkbox in the current import flow.

Priya: I drafted a 1-paragraph recruiter notice and a temporary policy: do not forward attachments; use the ATS viewer. Also enabling a stop-gap: disabling auto-forwarding of attachments to interview kits until we sanitize. :lock:

Evan: If you can share repro steps and one redacted log, I’ll scope the change. Please include the POST /imports payload ID and any 202/201 responses from the import service in the last 24h.

ATS-bot: [alert] import-service: 23 files failed metadata-scan (rule: pdf-xmp). Report: https://internal/reports/1812345678/scan.csv. Rule triggered on fields: attachments.metadata, attachments.xmpProducer.

Kaitlyn: I'll run a 15-minute sync with the recruiting team tomorrow 10:00am PT to go over do/don'ts and link to the temporary checklist. I'll also include a screenshot of how to create a flattened PDF (Mac Preview / Print -> Save as PDF).

Jamal: For the prototype job I can throw together a Dockerfile that runs exiftool and a small Node script to rewrite the S3 object. Rough command: exiftool -all= -overwrite_original "$FILE". I'll post the repo link shortly.

Priya: Action items summary: - Evan: infra PR to add import-time sanitize (opt-in flag) — target EOD. - Jamal: prototype exiftool job + sample Dockerfile. - Kaitlyn: recruiter comms + 10am training reminder. - Priya: file incident, notify Legal for potential disclosure review.

Evan: Sounds good. Ping me here with the sample logs and the report link and I'll open a branch and a draft PR.

Priya: Thanks everyone — will post incident number once filed and close the loop after PR merge. :white_check_mark:
